SKAdImpression.doc: A class that defines an ad impression for a view-through ad.

SKAdNetwork.doc: A class that validates advertisement-driven app installations.

SKCloudServiceController.doc: An object that determines the current capabilities of a person’s Music library.

SKCloudServiceSetupViewController.doc: A view controller that helps people perform setup for a cloud service, like an Apple Music subscription.

SKDownload.doc: Downloadable content associated with a product.

SKMutablePayment.doc: A mutable request to the App Store to process payment for additional functionality that your app offers.

SKOverlay.doc: A class that displays an overlay you can use to recommend another app or an App Clip’s corresponding full app.

SKOverlayAppClipConfiguration.doc: An object that represents the attributes of an overlay you use to recommend an App Clip’s corresponding full app.

SKOverlayAppConfiguration.doc: An object that represents the attributes of an overlay you use to recommend another app on the App Store.

SKOverlayConfiguration.doc: The abstract superclass for all classes that represent an overlay’s attributes.

SKOverlayTransitionContext.doc: A context object you can use to animate UI changes while the platform presents or dismisses an overlay.

SKPayment.doc: A request to the App Store to process payment for additional functionality that your app offers.

SKPaymentDiscount.doc: The signed discount to apply to a payment.

SKPaymentQueue.doc: A queue of payment transactions for the App Store to process.

SKPaymentTransaction.doc: An object in the payment queue.

SKProduct.doc: Information about a registered product in App Store Connect.

SKProductDiscount.doc: The details of an introductory offer or a promotional offer for an auto-renewable subscription.

SKProductStorePromotionController.doc: A product promotion controller for customizing the order and visibility of In-App Purchases per device.

SKProductSubscriptionPeriod.doc: An object containing the subscription period duration information.

SKProductsRequest.doc: An object that can retrieve localized information from the App Store about a specified list of products.

SKProductsResponse.doc: An App Store response to a request for information about a list of products.

SKReceiptRefreshRequest.doc: A request to the App Store to get the app receipt, which represents the customer’s transactions with your app.

SKRequest.doc: An abstract class that represents a request to the App Store.

SKStoreProductViewController.doc: A view controller that provides a page where customers can purchase media from the App Store.

SKStoreReviewController.doc: An object that controls the process of requesting App Store ratings and reviews from customers.

SKStorefront.doc: An object containing the location and unique identifier of an Apple App Store storefront.

SKCloudServiceSetupViewControllerDelegat.doc: A protocol that defines the methods a cloud service setup view controller can use to get the status of the view, including when it is dismissed.

SKDownloaderExtension.doc: An application extension that uses the system implementation to schedule Apple-hosted asset-pack downloads automatically.

SKOverlayDelegate.doc: Methods for responding to the overlay’s appearance, dismissal, or failure to load.

SKPaymentQueueDelegate.doc: The protocol that provides information needed to complete transactions.

SKPaymentTransactionObserver.doc: A set of methods that process transactions, unlock purchased functionality, and continue promoted In-App Purchases.

SKProductsRequestDelegate.doc: A set of methods the delegate implements so it receives the product information your app requests.

SKRequestDelegate.doc: Common methods that are implemented by delegates for any subclass of the SKRequest abstract class.

SKStoreProductViewControllerDelegate.doc: A protocol to call when the customer dismisses the store screen.

SKANError.doc: An error that an ad network attribution operation returns.

SKCloudServiceAuthorizationStatus.doc: Constants that indicate the type of authorization the customer has for accessing the Music library.

SKCloudServiceAuthorizationStatusAuthori.doc: The user authorizes playback of Apple Music tracks and the addition of tracks to their music library.

SKCloudServiceAuthorizationStatusDenied.doc: The user does not authorize any access to their music library.

SKCloudServiceAuthorizationStatusNotDete.doc: The authorization type cannot be determined.

SKCloudServiceAuthorizationStatusRestric.doc: Access to the music library is restricted in a way that the user cannot change, so your app should not prompt for authorization. An example of this situation is if the device is in an education mode.

SKCloudServiceCapability.doc: Constants that specify the current capabilities of the customer’s Music library on the device.

SKCloudServiceCapabilityAddToCloudMusicL.doc: The device allows tracks to be added to the user’s music library.

SKCloudServiceCapabilityMusicCatalogPlay.doc: The device allows playback of Apple Music catalog tracks.

SKCloudServiceCapabilityMusicCatalogSubs.doc: The device allows subscription to the Apple Music catalog.

SKCloudServiceCapabilityNone.doc: The device does not allow playback of Apple Music content or the addition of tracks to the music library.

init(rawValue:).doc: Initializes a cloud service capability with the provided raw value.

SKDownloadState.doc: The states that a download operation can be in.

SKDownloadStateActive.doc: Indicates that the content is currently being downloaded.

SKDownloadStateCancelled.doc: Indicates that your app canceled the download.

SKDownloadStateFailed.doc: Indicates that an error occurred while the file was being downloaded.

SKDownloadStateFinished.doc: Indicates that the content was successfully downloaded.

SKDownloadStatePaused.doc: Indicates that your app paused the download.

SKDownloadStateWaiting.doc: Indicates that the download has not started yet.

SKOverlayPosition.doc: Constants that identify the position of an overlay on the screen.

SKPaymentTransactionState.doc: Values representing the state of a transaction.

SKPaymentTransactionStateDeferred.doc: A transaction that is in the queue, but its final status is pending external action such as Ask to Buy.

SKPaymentTransactionStatePurchasing.doc: A transaction that is being processed by the App Store.

SKPaymentTransactionStateRestored.doc: A transaction that restores content previously purchased by the user.

SKProductDiscountPaymentMode.doc: Values representing the payment modes for a product discount.

SKProductDiscountType.doc: Values representing the types of discount offers an app can present.

SKProductPeriodUnit.doc: Values representing the duration of an interval, from a day up to a year.

SKProductStorePromotionVisibility.doc: The visibility settings that determine if an in-app purchase is visible on a device.

SKProductStorePromotionVisibilityDefault.doc: Indicates product visibility is the same as the default value set in App Store Connect.
